items.candidate_basis: Bound create and update handlers call duplicate-name and update paths, while owner association and validator nodes are present; four linked delivery episodes exercise duplicate-name behavior, persisted association, name validation, and update regression coverage.
items.candidate_capability: Companion record identity and update safeguards
limitations: Database uniqueness scripts and test behavior are delivery evidence but are not represented as graph nodes in the Java-only graph.
The graph does not provide cross-file edges between the controller, owner entity, and validator; convergence depends on shared delivery episodes.
The proposal intentionally does not decide whether creation, update, and validation are one Product Capability or several.

items.candidate_basis: Pet creation methods, owner aggregation, pet attribute mutators, and pet-type lookup form a coherent structural candidate for adding a typed, named, dated pet to an owner.
limitations: The graph does not prove the transaction or UI binding joining these components.

items.candidate_basis: The graph connects list display to pagination and exposes resource-list, repository-list, collection, and specialty-access nodes; delivery history co-changed the directory components for pagination and later refined specialty ordering and controller representation handling.
limitations: The pagination commit is broad and changes owner, visit, cache, and practitioner paths together, weakening boundary precision.
Two cited pull requests are maintenance or refactoring changes and do not independently prove an end-user capability.
The HTML and serialized representations are not nodes in the Java-only graph.

items.candidate_basis: The controller exposes find-form, find-processing, and paginated last-name search methods, while the repository exposes a matching last-name-prefix query. Together these are direct structural candidates for search and result navigation.
limitations: Graph structure does not expose rendered result links or request mappings.

items.candidate_basis: Visit creation and processing methods explicitly load a pet with a visit, while the Visit model exposes date and description mutation and Owner exposes visit aggregation.
limitations: The extracted graph does not demonstrate persistence success or validation behavior.

items.candidate_basis: VetController exposes list and pagination methods, VetRepository exposes collection retrieval, and Vets exposes a list accessor, providing convergent structure for veterinarian browsing.
limitations: List presentation and navigation controls are outside the Java-only graph.

items.candidate_basis: The owner detail entry point, owner-to-pets accessor, pet-to-visits accessor, and visit display fields form a structural chain for reviewing visit history in owner and pet context.
limitations: No view-template node confirms that the visit collection is rendered or ordered as history.

items.candidate_basis: The bound graph contains visit date accessors and controller nodes for minimum-date calculation and new-visit processing; one focused pull request changed both Java components together to validate future dates.
limitations: Only one delivery episode is cited, so independent repetition is absent.
No cross-file graph edge connects the visit entity and controller in this extraction.
The exact business exception policy and user wording are not established by the frozen evidence.

items.candidate_basis: WelcomeController.welcome is evidence for only the landing-page portion. Because the frozen capability also requires primary navigation and the Java-only graph contains no view or navigation nodes, the full capability cannot be mapped without exceeding the evidence boundary.
limitations: The WelcomeController remains partial evidence, not a realization proposal for the complete capability.
The Java-only graph contains no home template or navigation links.

items.candidate_basis: The graph exposes a find-form path into paginated owner lookup and a repository prefix-search operation; delivery episodes added owner-list pagination and later corrected whitespace handling on the same controller path.
items.candidate_capability: Client record search and result browsing
limitations: The graph has no direct controller-to-repository call edge, so the repository association is supported by co-change and naming rather than a graph path.
The graph does not index the HTML templates, so the visible pagination experience is inferred from delivery paths and subjects.
This proposal does not establish the Product Team's preferred terminology or boundary.

items.candidate_basis: The graph exposes locale resolution and locale-change interception registered in web configuration; one linked delivery episode changed that same configuration alongside multiple translation bundles and presentation templates.
limitations: Translation completeness and runtime rendering are not proven by the Java-only graph.
Only one delivery episode overlaps the web configuration and localized resources in this proposal.
Language coverage and terminology remain Product Team review questions.

items.candidate_basis: Creation-form controller methods align with record registration, and person/owner mutators structurally cover name, address, and telephone contact fields.
limitations: Persistence calls and field validation are not proven by the extracted cross-component graph.

items.candidate_basis: The PetController has explicit update initialization, processing, and detail-update methods, paired with Pet mutators for identifying classification data.
limitations: Name handling is inherited through NamedEntity and the graph does not establish form field coverage.

items.candidate_basis: Explicit owner update-form and show-owner methods support profile maintenance, while the Owner node exposes profile mutation and associated-pet access structure.
limitations: Associated activity rendering is inferred only from structural accessors, not template evidence.

items.candidate_basis: The veterinarian list entry point and Vet specialty accessors, together with the Specialty type, directly support a candidate realization for associating specialties with each listed veterinarian.
limitations: The graph does not include the view responsible for displaying specialty names.
